Breaking p1's orange monopoly is impossible without a large trade. I would likely help them build houses instead of stopping them.

I considered offering cash for individual orange properties, but p1 would refuse. They value their orange monopoly far more than St. Charles and a railroad, and I cannot offer them a complete pink set in return.

A cash offer for one orange property would not be enough to buy it. Even a large offer would leave me cash poor and lose my pink foothold. The real value is stopping p1 from building houses on their remaining two oranges, which would prevent them from snowballing.
